verdict.rationale: BigQuery continuous queries are SQL statements that run continuously and analyze incoming data in real time, which amounts to event-driven processing defined in SQL. Scheduled load jobs, transfers and Dataform workflow scheduling add automation, but those are time-based rather than event-triggered. missing for 10: evidence that rules can trigger downstream actions such as alerts, exports or webhooks on events; a documented event-trigger/rule configuration model; independent or hands-on corroboration.
